title: Align optical cuvette in benchtop spectrophotometer sample holder and close lid
instruction: Transfer the optical cuvette from the staging rack into the spectrophotometer sample holder, align its optical windows along the beam path, close the sample-compartment lid, and clear hands.
context: Routine analytical chemistry, molecular biology, and clinical diagnostic sample analysis (BLS SOC 19-4031: Chemical Technicians, >62,000 workers; BLS SOC 19-4021: Biological Technicians, >83,000 workers; BLS SOC 29-2010: Clinical Laboratory Technologists and Technicians, >342,000 workers; BLS SOC 19-2031: Chemists, >80,000 workers -> >567,000 professional laboratory and life-sciences personnel) operate benchtop UV-Vis spectrophotometers for quantitative absorbance, optical density (OD600), and kinetic assays.
setup: Benchtop UV-Vis spectrophotometer housing (240x200x110 mm chassis at (0.220, -0.040, 0.748) m on the table surface) with a recessed 18x18 mm sample socket pocket centered at (0.200, -0.040, 0.770) m with optical beam passage along Y, a light-tight hinged sample compartment lid propped open at 65.0 degrees at rear pivot (0.135, -0.040, 0.858) m with a USD revolute hinge joint, a standard 12.5x12.5x45.0 mm optical cuvette (mass 14.0 g) with frosted handling ribs along X and polished optical windows along Y staged upright at (0.200, 0.180, 0.770) m in a countertop polypropylene staging caddy.
scoring: Stage progression: 0.25: cuvette lifted vertically clear of staging rack (Z >= 0.795 m); 0.50: cuvette seated squarely and upright inside spectrophotometer sample socket (|dx| <= 18 mm, |dy| <= 18 mm, Z <= 0.805 m, tilt <= 25.0 deg); 0.75: cuvette seated squarely inside socket and hinged sample lid closed flush (angle <= 8.0 deg); 1.00: cuvette seated and lid closed flush right now, both robotic manipulator arms retracted clear (> 40 mm clearance) for >= 20 control steps (1.0 s at 20 Hz). Zero permanent positive latches (instantaneous physical state evaluation).
reset_notes: Place the standard optical cuvette upright inside the staging rack well at (0.200, 0.180, 0.770) m. Prop open the hinged sample compartment lid to 65.0 degrees where hinge joint limits hold initial orientation.
fidelity: 100% genuine dynamic contact bodies and USD revolute hinge joint with rotational limits (0 to 75 deg). Pure contact mechanics without synthetic pose writes or artificial welds.
